name: arin-jobfit-hosted
description: Arin JobFit (Hosted stateless edition) — HTTP MCP server for job-description analysis. Independent; not affiliated with Naukri or Indeed.

scripts.lint: eslint src tests && prettier --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsup.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json docs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsup.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json docs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run policy:lint
